description: The master section of the Chained Mixer: it sums every Channel module in its unbroken run of Chained Mixer modules and provides the stereo output

params.text: Sets the overall level of the aux 1 send bus, off at the bottom and 0dB at the top
Sets the overall level of the aux 2 send bus, off at the bottom and 0dB at the top
Sets the level at the outputs, silent at the bottom, 0dB at the marked position and 12dB at the top

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, one channel; with this jack alone patched it carries the whole mix summed to mono
The right side of the mix, one channel; with this jack alone patched it carries the whole mix summed to mono

notes: a mixer with no Master makes no sound, and Channel and Aux modules count only while they are in the same unbroken run of Chained Mixer modules as this one
with two Masters in one run, only the leftmost of them mixes anything
Channel modules on either side of this one are collected; on the right the collection stops at the first Aux module, so channels beyond it are left out of the mix
the lettering down the left of this panel, AUX1, AUX2, PAN/BAL, 0dB, SOLO and MUTE, names the controls of the Channel modules in the row, not controls of this module
